## Read half · decision to the maintainer · 2026-11-12T22:06Z

The decide half (approve / reject / reassign / send back exposed to AI with confirmation, `ApprovalService` the only gate) ships now in a `Refs #32442 (decide half)` PR from this seat's card thread. The read half ("an approver reads their pending requests through the existing record tools") cannot be built under the ruling without a new declared key, so it goes back to the maintainer. A fable review verified the dev's facts and found two more against B. When the decide half lands, this card is released in one stroke to `needs-user-decision` for the read half (it is in flight until then, so the six-state label moves at that moment).

Governing text: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` object-tool `guard` / `list_objects` filter (every `sys_*` object refused by name; only the host-wide `allowSystemObjects`); `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` `ObjectCapabilities` (no per-object AI key); ADR-0066 :78 and #27681 (exposure is declared by the author, no deployment switch); `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md` (a metadata-protocol addition is a spec sub-card, the product card `Blocked-by:` it).

| Option | What | Cost |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A (dev + fable recommend)** | Spec sub-card: a per-object, read-only AI exposure key, meaningful only on `sys_*` (lint refuses it elsewhere; stored-metadata families refused before the key is read), named like actions' `ai.exposed`. Server card: the bridge attests the object, the three mcp guards honour the attestation, `sys_approval_request` declares it; rows stay under `request-read-gate.ts` (the console's My Pending rows). | spec + mcp + runtime + approvals, ~2 PRs, `Metadata-protocol: added`, contract review |
| B | An exposed "my pending approvals" read action | Not cheaper: `ui/action.zod.ts` `method` enum has no `GET`; `run_action` is `destructiveHint: true` and needs `actions:execute`, so a read-only agent cannot see it and every list prompts a confirmation |
| C | Hard-code `sys_approval_request` as readable in mcp | Undeclared exception, contrary to #27681; repeats for the next system table |
| D | Decide only | The agent needs the request id from the user |

Flag (no ruling asked unless the maintainer reads "current approvers" literally): the service gate also admits the override holder (platform/tenant admin rescue, #3424), so an administrator's agent can override-decide like the administrator's button, behind confirmation. Narrowing it would be a check in the approval service, never in mcp.

Analysis: the card thread's `read-half-needs-decision.md`; review: `fable-review.md` (seat 5 project files).
